subject.title: [Feature]: Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as a first-class qwen plugin provider/auth choice, or keep it as custom-provider or third-party setup guidance for now?
rationale: This is a new provider id, env var, auth choice, endpoint, and catalog surface; repository policy treats provider/config additions as product and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Sponsor the linked provider PR
options.body: Have the qwen/provider owner review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94419, resolve conflicts, and land it if the new auth/config surface is accepted.

options.title: Reject bundled first-class support
options.body: Close the linked PR and document the supported custom-provider path or ClawHub/plugin path instead of adding a new bundled provider surface.

options.title: Defer for more vendor proof
options.body: Keep both items open until maintainers get stronger Alibaba docs or live provider-contract evidence for the endpoint, catalog, and naming.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the linked provider PR
recommendation.body: Have the qwen/provider owner review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94419, resolve conflicts, and land it if the new auth/config surface is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: Git history ties this person most directly to introducing and adjusting the qwen provider surface this request extends.
